package main

import (
	"github.com/spf13/cobra"
)

func newCmd() *cobra.Command {
	cmd := &cobra.Command{Use: "x"}
	f := cmd.Flags()
	f.String("old-flag", "", "old")
	f.String("new-flag", "", "new")
	f.String("secret", "", "s")
	_ = f.MarkDeprecated("old-flag", "use new-flag")
	_ = f.MarkHidden("secret")
	return cmd
}

func main() { _ = newCmd().Execute() }
